# Apple — Operating Margin, Last 8 Quarters

| Quarter ended | Revenue ($B) | Operating income ($B) | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2024-09-28 (FQ4'24) | 94.930 | 29.591 | **31.17%** ⚠️ derived |
| 2024-12-28 (FQ1'25) | 124.300 | 42.832 | **34.46%** |
| 2025-03-29 (FQ2'25) | 95.359 | 29.589 | **31.03%** |
| 2025-06-28 (FQ3'25) | 94.036 | 28.202 | **29.99%** |
| 2025-09-27 (FQ4'25) | 102.466 | 32.427 | **31.65%** ⚠️ derived |
| 2025-12-27 (FQ1'26) | 143.756 | 50.852 | **35.37%** |
| 2026-03-28 (FQ2'26) | 111.184 | 35.885 | **32.28%** |
| 2026-06-27 (FQ3'26) | 109.417 | 35.695 | **32.62%** |

⚠️ The two September quarters (FQ4'24 and FQ4'25) are **derived** figures — synthesized as FY minus Q1–Q3 from the FY filing dated 2025-10-31, not directly filed quarterly facts. All other quarters come from directly tagged `OperatingIncomeLoss` and `RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax` values in the 10-Qs filed on the dates shown.

## What the trend shows

**1. Strong seasonality dominates the quarter-to-quarter pattern.** The December (fiscal Q1) holiday quarter is the annual peak both times — 34.46% in Dec-2024 and 35.37% in Dec-2025 — while the June quarter is the trough. Comparing like-for-like quarters is the more meaningful read.

**2. On a year-over-year basis, margin is up in every comparable quarter:**
- Sept: 31.17% → 31.65%
- Dec: 34.46% → 35.37%
- Mar: 31.03% → 32.28%
- Jun: 29.99% → 32.62% (the largest gain, ~2.6 points)

**3. The low point was FQ3'25 (June 2025) at 29.99%** — the only quarter below 30% in the series — and margin has expanded in each of the three quarters since.

**4. Gross margin is the driver.** Gross margin climbed steadily from 46.22% (Sep-2024) to 50.06% (Jun-2026), crossing 50% for the first time in this window. Operating margin rose less than gross margin over the same span (31.17% → 32.62%), which indicates operating expenses grew somewhat faster than revenue, partially offsetting the gross-margin gains.

**5. Net margin followed a similar shape** — 24.92% at the June-2025 trough, 27.23% in the latest quarter. Note the 15.52% net margin in Sep-2024 is an outlier driven by the one-time European Commission state-aid tax charge Apple recorded that quarter; operating margin that quarter (31.17%) was unaffected, since the charge sat below the operating line.
